results.title: Super Contribution Caps (2026/2027)
results.description:
# Super contributions caps (2026/2027)
## Concessional (before-tax) contributions cap
| Financial years | Yearly concessional contributions cap |
|-|-|
| July 2026 – June 2027 | $32,500 |
| July 2025 – June 2026 | $30,000 |

The concessional contributions cap for the 2026-27 financial year is $32,500. In other words, you can make up to $32,500 in before-tax contributions in one financial year before facing extra taxes. Keep in mind this includes any [Superannuation Guarantee (SG)](https://rest.com.au/super/learn/essentials/super-guarantee) contributions made by your employer, as well as any [salary sacrifice amounts](https://rest.com.au/super/grow-my-super/salary-sacrifice). For more information about what are considered concessional contributions, [visit the ATO website](https://www.ato.gov.au/Individuals/Super/Growing-and-keeping-track-of-your-super/Caps-limits-and-tax-on-super-contributions/Understanding-concessional-and-non-concessional-contributions/#Concessionalcontributions).

### Carrying forward your unused concessional contributions caps
You could be eligible if:

- your total super balance is less than $500,000 at the end of the previous financial year
- you have unused concessional cap amounts available from up to the previous five financial years

[Learn more on the ATO website](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/super/growing-and-keeping-track-of-your-super/caps-limits-and-tax-on-super-contributions/concessional-contributions-cap#Carryforwardunusedcontributions).

#### Case study: Macy wants to carry forward her unused caps
| Financial year | Concessional contributions cap | Macy’s concessional contributions | Unused concessional contributions cap available to carry forward |
|-|-|-|-|
|  |  | **Total unused concessional contributions:** | $92,000 |

For 2026-27, the concessional contributions cap is $32,500.

**Macy’s maximum concessional contribution for 2026-27:** $92,500 + $32,500 = $124,500

results.description:
# Time to revise your superannuation strategy: changes to concessional and non-concessional caps
- From 1 July 2026, superannuation contribution caps will increase, with the concessional cap rising to $32,500 and the non‑concessional cap to $130,000, alongside the transfer balance cap increasing to $2.1m.

### Relevant changes
The concessional contribution cap will increase from $30,000 to $32,500 from 1 July 2026.

The concessional contribution cap is indexed to average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE), in increments of $2,500.

### How does this impact the bring-forward rule?
| TSB at 30 June 2026 | Maximum NCC | Bring forward period |
|-|-|-|
| <$1,840,000 | $390,000 | 3 years |
| <$1,970,000 | $260,000 | 2 years |
